prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Katy, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1461; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was changing lanes on a multi-lane road in Katy, Texas, checking my mirror and signaling before I moved over. As I started to merge, a vehicle in the adjacent lane made contact with the side of my car, pushing me toward the shoulder before I could fully correct. Both cars stopped at the roadside, and I stayed with my vehicle while we exchanged information. The next morning my neck and upper back were stiff and sore, and over the following days the pain spread into my shoulders and caused headaches. I have given the same account of how the collision happened to everyone who has asked, including the responding officer, my doctor, and the claims team. I am the named driver on the policy under which I am filing this claim.
